title: Value pages leave about 50pt of empty band under the last line, and show "Tap a value to correct it." right under "No values yet."
evidence: Seen in the PR 1508 shots: about 50pt of empty space sits under the last line of a value page. With no values the page shows "No values yet." and then "Tap a value to correct it.", a hint with nothing to tap. (H82)
